title: IOP GWAS enloc colocalization results
bodyHtml: This table contains the significant enloc colocalization results for intraocular pressure (IOP) GWAS loci (Khawaja et al., 2018) by QTL type, target gene, and tissue combinations tested across 49 GTEx tissues and peripheral retina. All e/sVariants within an LD interval (r2<0.1 plus 50kb on either side) around 133 lead GWAS variants were tested in the colocalization analysis. Significance was determined at a regional colocalization probability (RCP) > 0.1. The probability that a variant may be causal to the GWAS trait, posterior inclusion probability (PIP), was computed with DAP-G and provided for each significantly colocalizing e/sVariant (QTL PIP). To filter out potential false positives, we flagged cases where the GWAS p-value of the colocalization e/sVariant was above 1E-05 and/or whose e/sQTL p-value was above 1E-04 or FDR above 0.05 (FALSE in Column: 'Pass QC (QTL FDR<0.05 or Plt;1E04 and GWAS Plt;1E05)'). Chromosome positions are in genome build 38. The table was taken from Supplementary Data 12 in Hamel et al., 2024.
